name: Wiki Fact Criteria
description: Wikipedia article factual accuracy and citation evaluation criteria

verifiability.name: Verifiability
verifiability.description: Evaluates the factual consistency between generated article and Wikipedia ground truth article

gen_to_wiki.name: Gen → Wiki Direction
gen_to_wiki.description: Verifies how well statements in the generated article are supported by Wikipedia

items.name: Supported by Wiki
items.description: Proportion of Gen statements that are supported by Wiki content

items.name: Not Supported by Wiki
items.description: Proportion of Gen statements that Wiki does not mention

items.name: Conflict with Wiki
items.description: Proportion of Gen statements that contradict Wiki content

wiki_to_gen.name: Wiki → Gen Direction
wiki_to_gen.description: Verifies how well the generated article covers Wikipedia content

items.name: Covered by Gen
items.description: Proportion of Wiki statements that are covered by Gen content

items.name: Not Covered by Gen
items.description: Proportion of Wiki statements that Gen does not mention

items.name: Conflict with Gen
items.description: Proportion of Wiki statements that contradict Gen content

prompts.system: You are a professional data annotator. Given a sentence and a paragraph composed of several gold factual support sentences, your task is to verify whether the sentence is consistent with the facts. Matching any single support sentence is enough for consistency.

decision_policy.consistent: At least one support sentence directly entails or clearly confirms the statement.
decision_policy.inconsistent: At least one support sentence clearly contradicts the statement.
decision_policy.not_support: No support sentence clearly confirms or contradicts the statement (insufficient evidence).

citation.name: Citation
citation.description: Evaluates whether statements in the generated article are supported by their cited sources

support_ratio.name: Support Ratio
support_ratio.description: Proportion of statements that are supported by their cited sources

conflict_ratio.name: Conflict Ratio
conflict_ratio.description: Proportion of statements that contradict their cited sources

coverage_ratio.name: Coverage Ratio
coverage_ratio.description: Proportion of statements that have citations

prompts.system: You are a fact verification expert. Follow the instructions carefully and output only valid JSON.

decision_policy.support: The citation content clearly supports or is consistent with the statement.
decision_policy.not_support: The citation content does not provide enough information to support the statement.
decision_policy.conflict: The citation content contradicts the statement.
